summary: Completed comprehensive testing of VendezVotreCar MVP - French car buyback website for Belgium. All core features working perfectly including homepage, multi-step estimation form, contact functionality, and backend APIs.
passed_tests: Homepage loads with hero section, trust badges, testimonials, and process steps
Navigation between all pages works correctly
Multi-step estimation form (4 steps) functions perfectly with validation
Form submission creates estimation in database and redirects to thank you page
Contact form submission works and creates contact message in database
All static pages load successfully (How it works, Vehicle types, FAQ, About, Legal, Privacy, Cookies)
All 8 backend API endpoints working (100% success rate)
API validation working correctly (RGPD consent required)
